flowerScoringVolume.description: Official BIOBUZZ FLOWER scoring cylinder. The archived STEP and analytic dimensions are canonical; the GLB is a 128-segment visual preview only.

placementEvidence.method: Match the scoring cylinder and Layer C circular edge in the official FLOWER assembly; map that edge into the full-field STEP. This places the lower plane at the HIPS pipe lower end.
placementEvidence.coordinateTransform: Source (x,y,z) becomes simulator (x,z,-y), then each instance translation is applied. The analytic solid is axially symmetric.

flowerScoringVolume.ruleUse: V1 section 10.5.2: analytic sphere/closed-cylinder intersection, including partial overlap. The solid defines membership only; it is never a physical collider or a capacity limit.
flowerScoringVolume.status: Official scoring-volume STEP exported and hash-pinned; analytic cylinder used for scoring, never as a physical collider.

assumptions: The source STEP coordinate basis is preserved because inspection confirms it is already Y-up; the FTC field-plane mapping is X/-Z.
POLLEN and NECTAR collider spheres use nominal diameters; the official manual notes size and sphericity variation.
No Hive assembly mass, centre-of-mass model, damping coefficient, restitution, friction coefficient, or calibrated transition angle is asserted here; these remain physics-layer inputs or assumptions.
